material_news_signals.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua likely to be placed on injured reserve with turf toe, sprained MCL and PCL
material_news_signals.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is likely to be placed on injured reserve after suffering a turf toe injury and spraining his MCL and PCL in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders, head coach Sean McVay said Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the rams have lost another star to injury wide receiver puka nacua is likely to be placed on injured reserve after suffering a turf toe injury and spraining his mcl and pcl in sunday s 20 13 win over the commanders head coach sean mcvay said monday i m bummed for puka mcvay said i feel for him i feel for all of our players that are getting these kinds of injuries it s challenging but it s an opportunity for us to adjust and adapt the game s gonna be played but you feel for the players first and foremost nacua a two time pro bowler has 70 receptions for 715 yards and four touchdowns in seven games this season in the outing against washington he was targeted 19 times with 150 yards and a score on 14 catches this marks the latest in a lengthy list of ailments for nacua this season as he was affected by psoas soreness throughout training camp and sat weeks 2 and 3 due to a hip injury but the turf toe and knee sprain will lead to his longest absence yet nacua is set to join fellow star wideout davante adams hamstring on ir leaving the rams with a wr corps of tutu atwell konata mumpfield jordan whittington and cj daniels plus a tight end group of tyler higbee colby parkinson and davis allen that is frequently used in the passing attack it remains to be seen when tight end terrance ferguson might rejoin that group the most athletic with perhaps the highest ceiling of los angeles tight ends he initially was expected to come off ir for week 9 after recovering from an ankle injury only to hurt his hamstring during friday s practice though l a has dealt with the absence of many big names on both sides of the ball nacua missing extended time will prove especially detrimental to a rams offense that hasn t clicked at all times in 2026 over the past two games matthew stafford has thrown for 385 yards two touchdowns and two interceptions hardly looking like the mvp quarterback he was in 2025 and lacking other difference making pass catchers becoming laser focused on nacua to keep things moving nacua saw a 48 target share in week 8 against the chargers and a 44 2 share on sunday meaning the rams will have to compensate for nearly half of their recent passing offense now gone should nacua go on ir as mcvay expressed is likely he will miss the next four games plus a bye week against the cardinals packers chiefs and 49ers before being eligible to return in week 15 against the cowboys

material_news_signals.headline: Report: Ravens not expected to trade RB Derrick Henry before Nov. 10 deadline
material_news_signals.description: The Baltimore Ravens are not expected to trade running back Derrick Henry before the Nov. 10 deadline, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday.
material_news_signals.body_text: any team riding a four game losing streak into the trade deadline will generate some questions about potential roster moves that is doubly so for a would be contender like the ravens who are without quarterback lamar jackson for the foreseeable future due to a thumb injury but espn s adam schefter reported on saturday that baltimore is not expected to trade running back derrick henry schefter added that the team recently informed henry it did not intend to move him and henry echoed similar sentiments about his own desires following a 33 10 thursday night loss to the jaguars i have not mentioned me going anywhere else henry said when asked if he plans to still be with the team beyond the nov 10 deadline per team transcript i m saying let s go back to work let s try to get better and turn this thing around the ravens 4 5 are staring up at the rest of their rivals in a highly competitive afc north they re currently the only team in the division with a losing record with jackson on injured reserve and backup tyler huntley toe out for the season joe fagnano was overwhelmed and ineffective in a prime time drubbing at the hands of the jags suggesting there will be little resistance to the newly acquired jacoby brissett taking over the qb1 spot moving forward after his trade from the cardinals was finalized acquiring brissett in the first place suggests the ravens are still going for it which would require all hands on deck especially those of a five time pro bowler with 13 707 career rushing yards baltimore s problems at this point go beyond the void left by jackson s injury even though a signal caller of his caliber could have helped compensate for weaknesses elsewhere the ravens defense has given up 30 plus points in three straight and henry has been stymied over the past month after rushing for 476 yards and seven touchdowns with a 4 2 yards per carry average during his first five games henry has only managed 213 rushing yards a score and 3 4 yards per attempt over his last four without a game over 60 yards on the ground during that span it s why he s far more concerned with how to turn things around and move up in the standings than the outside noise of possibly moving anywhere else the ravens have a mini bye week now to get right then henry and co have four straight games against teams with losing records before a month s worth of afc north bouts to close out the campaign we have to henry said when asked if he believes baltimore can turn it around it s the only thing we can do is go back to work and try to get it going

material_news_signals.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams undaunted by 4-INT night in win over Bucs: 'I'm going to keep grippin' it, keep rippin' it'
material_news_signals.description: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams threw four interceptions, but led the game-winning drive to move to 7-2 on the season.
material_news_signals.body_text: caleb williams career high four interception night in a last second 27 24 win over the tampa bay buccaneers won t make the chicago bears quarterback gun shy i m going to throw until i can t throw anymore williams said via espn that s how i live i work my tail off to be in this position i ll never not throw the ball i could throw 100 picks in one game if it comes down to it i m going to throw that pass that i did to tight end https www nfl com players colston loveland or if it s a tighter window i m going to rip it in there that s how i grew up that s who i am i don t get gun shy that s not me that s not my identity that s not who i am with that i m going to keep grippin it keep rippin it and coach calls it it s time to go make a play the four ints were the most for williams in the nfl college or high school per nfl research chicago got off to a scorching start sunday night with williams ripping off platform throws all over the field as the bears built a 14 0 lead on two flawless drives then the interceptions started williams threw picks on three of the next four drives he got greedy on his first int trying to fit a ball to rome odunze at the goal line between two defenders his next two turnovers were poor attempts to throw the ball away the final int came when bucs cornerback jacob parrish tipped a pass and linebacker alex anzalone snagged it through it all the bears maintained their lead with a ferocious defensive effort that kept forcing punts and generated a couple of turnovers of their own chicago s fifth turnover came late in the fourth quarter when wide receiver luther burden took a helmet shot that caused a concussion and fumbled deep in his own territory tampa turned the fumble into the game tying td and converted the two point try despite the second half struggles in which chicago had a single first down on its first six drives williams let it rip on the final possession the qb converted a big first down coming out of the two minute warning then found colston loveland deep for 38 yards to set up the game winning field goal despite the displeasure i might be presenting right now there s a lot of good in terms of building this team that comes from a win like this because it s like i said one it s hard to win under those circumstances coach ben johnson said we really haven t been in that situation where in the fourth quarter with little time left needing to go and field goal touchdown whatever that is it just hasn t happened a whole lot this year and yet i feel like our guys we are prepped for that and we re ready for it that s what i know now after going through that i know as a play caller i certainly felt great it was as calm as i felt on calling plays there that last drive as i was all game long sunday marked the third time since 2000 the bears have won a game committing at least five turnovers the previous two such games came in the 2006 season when they appeared in super bowl xli williams four ints were the most by any quarterback in a win since jared goff had five interceptions in a week 10 2024 win over the texans also on sunday night football williams performance against the bucs blitzes told the story he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz then he went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives on the game winning drive he completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz they sent the same blitz a couple of times and they got through and that s what happens williams said when a defense sends a similar blitz or sends a blitz over and over that just means that they re getting through that means they re going to keep going until we stop it we have to find ways to get better we have to find ways to push through that we have to find ways when it does happen we have to make the adjustments and then when it does happen i have to be the big eraser it wasn t pretty for williams whose impressive 70 completion percentage entering the game took a hit but it didn t cost the bears a win in a hotly contested nfc north race and that s what really matters

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Network: Ravens' Lamar Jackson (right thumb) out 6-9 weeks, expects to return this season
material_news_signals.description: Lamar Jackson's latest injury has sidetracked the Ravens' 2026 season, but the two-time MVP may not be lost for the year.
material_news_signals.body_text: lamar jackson s latest injury has sidetracked the ravens 2026 season leaving them to trade for journeyman jacoby brissett this week amid a 4 5 start but the two time mvp may not be lost for the year the baltimore signal caller suffered a fractured and dislocated thumb on his right hand on nov 1 and is expected to miss at least six weeks after undergoing surgery nfl network s ian rapoport reported sunday jackson could miss up to nine weeks with his recovery which would put his return to play around the start of the postseason at the latest if the ravens make it that far rapoport reported that jackson told his teammates after week 8 that he plans to return later this season the ravens qb was initially reported to be out indefinitely with jackson and tyler huntley out for the season with turf toe placed on injured reserve the ravens were forced to start undrafted third stringer joe fagnano on thursday night against jacksonville it did not go well the ravens then acquired brissett on friday in a trade with hopes that the veteran qb can lead baltimore to enough wins in the ensuing weeks to make a jackson return worthwhile baltimore faces the chargers panthers texans and buccaneers a combined 8 21 record in the next five weeks before finishing the season with four games in the brutal afc north the ravens are currently last in the division jackson has started five games this season his first under coach jesse minter but has finished just three he left baltimore s week 4 game with an ankle sprain and missed three weeks upon his return in week 8 jackson was knocked out of the game on the ravens first offensive snap when his right hand collided with a bills defender on the season jackson is 68 of 97 passing for 967 yards six touchdowns and one interception adding 144 rushing yards and a td brissett started all eight of the cardinals games before being benched midway through their week 8 comeback win over dallas he was demoted to third string the following day and then dealt to baltimore the 33 year old journeyman has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 tds and seven ints this season brissett will try to keep baltimore afloat with the expectation that jackson can return to a playoff bound ravens team and take them over the top

material_news_signals.headline: Report: Ravens not expected to trade RB Derrick Henry before Nov. 10 deadline
material_news_signals.description: The Baltimore Ravens are not expected to trade running back Derrick Henry before the Nov. 10 deadline, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday.
material_news_signals.body_text: any team riding a four game losing streak into the trade deadline will generate some questions about potential roster moves that is doubly so for a would be contender like the ravens who are without quarterback lamar jackson for the foreseeable future due to a thumb injury but espn s adam schefter reported on saturday that baltimore is not expected to trade running back derrick henry schefter added that the team recently informed henry it did not intend to move him and henry echoed similar sentiments about his own desires following a 33 10 thursday night loss to the jaguars i have not mentioned me going anywhere else henry said when asked if he plans to still be with the team beyond the nov 10 deadline per team transcript i m saying let s go back to work let s try to get better and turn this thing around the ravens 4 5 are staring up at the rest of their rivals in a highly competitive afc north they re currently the only team in the division with a losing record with jackson on injured reserve and backup tyler huntley toe out for the season joe fagnano was overwhelmed and ineffective in a prime time drubbing at the hands of the jags suggesting there will be little resistance to the newly acquired jacoby brissett taking over the qb1 spot moving forward after his trade from the cardinals was finalized acquiring brissett in the first place suggests the ravens are still going for it which would require all hands on deck especially those of a five time pro bowler with 13 707 career rushing yards baltimore s problems at this point go beyond the void left by jackson s injury even though a signal caller of his caliber could have helped compensate for weaknesses elsewhere the ravens defense has given up 30 plus points in three straight and henry has been stymied over the past month after rushing for 476 yards and seven touchdowns with a 4 2 yards per carry average during his first five games henry has only managed 213 rushing yards a score and 3 4 yards per attempt over his last four without a game over 60 yards on the ground during that span it s why he s far more concerned with how to turn things around and move up in the standings than the outside noise of possibly moving anywhere else the ravens have a mini bye week now to get right then henry and co have four straight games against teams with losing records before a month s worth of afc north bouts to close out the campaign we have to henry said when asked if he believes baltimore can turn it around it s the only thing we can do is go back to work and try to get it going

material_news_signals.description: Josh Jacobs will undergo surgery on his fractured finger this week, Green Bay coach Matt LaFleur said Monday. His timeline to return is "to be determined," LaFleur added.

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Week 9 Sunday aftermath: Myles Garrett's return buoys Rams; Jordan Love, Joe Burrow shine
material_news_signals.description: Kevin Patra breaks down the key storylines from Week 9's slate of games on Sunday, including Myles Garrett's return to action for the Rams and the explosive outings from Jordan Love and Joe Burrow.
material_news_signals.body_text: we re at the season s halfway point and sunday saw a number of teams and quarterbacks make loud statements as we gear up for 2026 s stretch run the nfc north continues to be an absolute buzzsaw of a division going 3 0 on sunday with the vikings set to face the bills on monday night the afc north is shaping up to be a two team race and the seahawks got back over 500 with sam darnold sidelined let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including prolific packers attack fueled by deep ball burrow marching toward first mvp another one score win for payton s broncos giants overcome adversity once again stroud s historic afternoon in los angeles but first we start with the rams who saw the return of their prized offseason acquisition and immediately reaped the benefits garrett to the rams rescue welcome back myles garrett the nfl sack champion returned from a seven game stint on injured reserve to bolster the rams pass rush which had struggled to pester signal callers without the two time defensive player of the year garrett didn t just return to the lineup on sunday no no no he blasted off like a heat seeking missile at commanders quarterback jayden daniels first there was the second quarter strip sack that set up points then in the fourth quarter garrett walloped daniels twice for two pivotal sacks that helped seal the win on a day the offense couldn t find a groove man it was a weight off my shoulders garrett said of the three sacks that helped key l a s 20 13 win in his return from september knee surgery just getting back to who i am i m nowhere near where i want to be as far as like my performance and the things i know i can do how i can move but this is a confidence booster for sure just try to boost the confidence of the guys around me as well garrett played 35 of 58 defensive snaps 60 3 in his return from injury he generated six pressures and three sacks on 27 pass rushes 22 2 pressure rate per next gen stats getting the dominant edge rusher back will also make aaron donald more menacing sunday was the first time this season that garrett and donald were active together with both on the field 23 plays the rams defense allowed 5 0 yards per play and recorded four sacks per ngs on all other plays the defense allowed 8 1 yards per play and one touchdown with zero sacks as the duo plays together more the upside is enormous garrett s return is massive for a rams squad that has struggled this season they re finally on the right side of 500 at 5 4 but still have work to do to get into playoff positioning with puka nacua s reported knee injury adding uncertainty to sean mcvay s offense the l a d might need to carry the load for the next few weeks editor s update sean mcvay told reporters monday that wr puka nacua has mcl and pcl sprains and a turf toe injury and will probably be placed on injured reserve packers air it out to demolish pats many offenses prefer to dink and dunk their way down the field executing the kind of safe approach that doesn t put the ball at risk and keeps the attack in advantageous down and distance situations and then there is green bay jordan love entered sunday already leading the league in splash plays then he dropped dime after dime after deep dime on a bewildered patriots defense in foxborough the packers qb along with burner christian watson 7 171 1 and ascending second year wideout matthew golden 10 164 1 made pats star cb christian gonzalez look like a sixth round scrub putting himself squarely in the mvp conversation love generated 372 passing yards three passing touchdowns and a regular season career high 153 2 passer rating in green bay s 45 27 shellacking of the patriots he joined aaron rodgers as the only packers quarterbacks with multiple passing touchdowns in at least eight of the first nine games of a season with rodgers doing so in 2011 and 2020 winning mvp in each of those seasons love s 153 2 passer rating in week 9 is the highest by any packers quarterback in a regular season start since rodgers had a perfect 158 3 against the raiders in 2019 it really doesn t matter who it is on defense love said after the game we trust the game plan and trust guys are gonna get open and make plays it s the nfl we see great dbs every week our mindset is we gotta keep attacking attack they did love was flawless and his deep shots were on the freaking money when he s driving the ball downfield hitting receivers in stride there isn t a prettier sight in the game right now love completed 10 of his 12 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 294 yards and two touchdowns against the patriots the third most downfield passing yards by a quarterback this season per next gen stats he averaged 24 5 yards per attempt on those downfield passes the fifth most in a single game since 2018 he completed six of his eight deep attempts 20 air yards for 235 yards and one touchdown better still love was pressured on nine pass attempts he completed six of those for 153 yards averaging a whopping 17 0 ypa when pressured per ngs those numbers are pure comedy but it s crazy because i know there s probably a lot more in there golden said we ve still got so many more plays out there to make there are still aspects to clean up with the offensive line still somewhat of a mess and the ground game not getting into gear until late with josh jacobs now dealing with a fractured finger the pack could use some rb help jonathan taylor anyone but when love is on the money and his two dynamic receivers aren t flubbing passes the pack can score with anyone with the lions escaping miami on sunday with a 19 9 win over the fighting fins and the bears overcoming five turnovers to best the buccaneers at home the nfc north continues to be the hottest division in the league is anyone playing better than burrow jordan love is on fire but joe burrow has been blazing for a month the bengals quarterback in sunday s 34 17 win over the falcons generated his fourth straight game with at least four passing rushing touchdowns tied for the second longest streak since 1970 behind only peyton manning s five game streak in his 2004 mvp season per nfl research over the past four tilts burrow has a thrown hilarious 16 touchdown passes while completing 77 of his passes becoming just the fourth qb fifth instance overall to pull off that feat joining tom brady 2007 manning 2013 and russell wilson 2015 and 2020 joe is playing at an unbelievably high level right now bengals head coach zac taylor said joe doesn t force the ball he takes the ball where it needs to go based on the looks and even if sometimes they re leaning into a guy or doubling a guy he s still going to give him an opportunity and some of those opportunities came up big for us so that s just something we re used to it helps to have ja 39 marr chase 10 155 1 and tee higgins 5 32 2 on your side as they did at lsu burrow and chase toasted falcons corner a j terrell with a 47 yard td bomb to get the ball rolling on a 24 point first half that all but sealed a win in madrid before the break chase was asked after the game if burrow is playing like an mvp i can t answer that because i ve been playing with him my whole life so it s kind of hard for me to sit up here and say that chase said but i ve been thinking he should have won the mvp i said this when we went to the super bowl that year and he didn t get it that year i mean he s up for it every year broncos magic in one score games continues credit sean payton s squad for continuing to come up clutch streaking to their fifth consecutive victory on sunday four of which have come by less than a touchdown sunday s 26 21 win over the panthers came after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter the broncos fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that ties the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 per nfl research both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game on wild card weekend i think it s just the character of our guys the toughness competitiveness of our guys broncos quarterback bo nix said after the game we re just comfortable in that moment when things get close there at the end of the game whatever it is we have had a couple scores and then we always want to make it one score just glad we re on this side and winning em the broncos jumped out to a 10 0 advantage before the panthers got back in the game and took a third quarter lead carolina controlled the middle portion of the game but nix and co took over late with two fourth quarter touchdown drives capped by a 26 yard strike from nix to pat bryant after the offense failed to get a game sealing first down late the defense stepped up and forced a fumble to squash the panthers final drive i just think we ve been there before so we know how to handle the situation nik bonitto who had the game sealing strip sack of bryce young said at the end of the day it was our job as a defense to just go out and finish the victory set an nfl record with their 16th consecutive regular season win in a one score contest broncos games are rarely normal sunday s included a miraculous interception in the end zone that took a replay review of when material_news_signals.headline: Jaguars acquire Eagles DT Jordan Davis in blockbuster trade
material_news_signals.description: The Jaguars are trading for Eagles defensive tackle Jordan Davis, sending a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick to Philadelphia, the teams announced on Monday.

second round selection to philadelphia the teams announced on monday the deal marks the third trade for a defensive player of the day for the jaguars after acquiring falcons safety jessie bates and saints defensive tackle davon godchaux it s a stunning flurry of moves from jaguars general manager james gladstone who surrendered tremendous draft capital five total picks including a first and two seconds to revamp his team s defense a day before the league s trade deadline the moves on monday were made to combat the season ending injuries to starting safety eric murray and defensive tackle for loss and three qb hits in nine games this season davis excels as a dynamic space eater in the middle his 23 run stops are second in the league among dts and his 28 run tackles are tied for fourth per next gen stats in 2025 davis totaled 63 run tackles and 50 run stops which were both second among defensive tackles it shows that the jaguars 6 2 believe they are well positioned for a title run in an afc where they began monday jostling for playoff positioning with the one loss bills and a host of fellow two loss teams broncos chiefs steelers and bengals for the eagles the decision to move on from davis further underscores that it is a lost season in philly we are extremely grateful to jordan for his contributions to our team on the field and in the philadelphia community since we drafted him five years ago the eagles said in a statement he has been a key contributor to our team culture and on field success which included two super bowl appearances and a world championship in material_news_signals.body_text: berea ohio the cleveland browns lost an overtime heartbreaker sunday in new orleans but their late rally behind shedeur sanders might be making coach todd monken reconsider the team 39 s immediate quarterback plans monken told cleveland reporters monday afternoon that he hadn 39 t yet met with the full offensive coaching staff as part of the team 39 s standard after game procedure and that he 39 s not ready to name a starter for sunday 39 s home game against the houston texans deshaun watson who started the season 39 s first eight games cleared concussion protocol on saturday but did not play in new orleans the browns spent the week preparing sanders to make his first start of the season after a sluggish first three quarters the sanders led browns scored on three of their final four possessions of the fourth and overtime before failing on a two point conversion that sealed a 23 22 saints victory if monken is willing to rethink the quarterback plan he 39 s followed since the summer it 39 s because the offense has rarely clicked before the final quarter this season all five of cleveland 39 s wins have come on fourth quarter drives engineered by watson and those comebacks have masked prolonged stretches of bad offense by the browns who are the league 39 s most penalized team in new orleans sunday they had more first quarter penalty yards 25 than total yards 19 in addressing the ongoing penalty problems monken said monday that 34 you are what your tape says you are 34 and the full tape says the browns have been inconsistent offensively regardless of who 39 s been at quarterback so perhaps the way sanders finished the game in new orleans will drive some further debate after he threw for 197 of his 297 yards in the fourth quarter and overtime the 5 4 browns have lost two straight but remain just 1 5 games behind pittsburgh and cincinnati in the afc north and a game behind current qualification for one of the afc 39 s three wild card spots the browns have played six of their first nine on the road and they lost sunday in their third straight road game the team 39 s bye is set for week 11 34 we 39 re right there in the mix and i do believe our best football is in front of us 34 monken said 34 we have our next four at home and a bye week it 39 s all right there in front of us 34 if the browns fall out of playoff contention later this season the sensible move would be to replace watson to further evaluate sanders watson is in the final year of the 230 million contract the browns gave him after acquiring him in a march 2022 trade while sanders is on his standard rookie deal through 2028 for now though the browns are alive and though sanders needed three plus quarters to produce anything in new orleans his willingness to throw the ball downfield added a new element to the offense sanders hit rookie denzel boston on a 60 yard pass in the first half then gave the browns the lead at 13 9 on a 64 yard throw to rookie kc concepcion in the final six minutes 34 i 39 m awfully proud of shedeur 34 monken said 34 it had been 10 weeks since he really had reps with the starters in practice i was hopeful he would play because he had a great week of practice i thought he battled and showed composure in the pocket he made some plays with his feet the operation for the most part was clean 34 there was a lot there to like certainly a lot to clean up 133 but a lot to build on 34 the browns have struggled to protect the quarterback and their inability to create much in the run game has contributed watson has been sacked a league high 33 times across his eight starts he 39 s been pressured on 40 7 percent of his dropbacks per trumedia the league 39 s seventh highest rate among starting quarterbacks sanders was sacked five times by new orleans but made the day 39 s best throw under heavy pressure from saints defensive end chase young connecting with jerry jeudy as the browns set up the game tying field goal in the final 30 seconds of regulation watson has completed 65 5 percent of his passes with seven touchdowns and three interceptions he 39 s thrown five of those touchdown passes in fourth quarters when his passer rating jumps from 98 0 to 106 5 monken chose watson in the summer because he believed his experience would be best for a remade offense facing a road heavy stretch and that watson should shake off the rust after two achilles tendon surgeries and 22 months out watson has generally avoided turnovers and made the occasional highlight reel throw but his accuracy has been shaky overall browns players are off tuesday and the week 39 s first full practice is set for wednesday afternoon monken said he didn 39 t feel any pressure to make a decision by monday or early tuesday though the upcoming bye week might provide a more natural bridge to a change it sounds like sanders 39 play might spark further discussion as the browns go through the rest of their early week process material_news_signals.body_text: we re at the season s halfway point and sunday saw a number of teams and quarterbacks make loud statements as we gear up for 2026 s stretch run the nfc north continues to be an absolute buzzsaw of a division going 3 0 on sunday with the vikings set to face the bills on monday night the afc north is shaping up to be a two team race and the seahawks got back over 500 with sam darnold sidelined let s examine some key storylines in sunday s aftermath including prolific packers attack fueled by deep ball burrow marching toward first mvp another one score win for payton s broncos giants overcome adversity once again stroud s historic afternoon in los angeles but first we start with the rams who saw the return of their prized offseason acquisition and immediately reaped the benefits garrett to the rams rescue welcome back myles garrett the nfl sack champion returned from a seven game stint on injured reserve to bolster the rams pass rush which had struggled to pester signal callers without the two time defensive player of the year garrett didn t just return to the lineup on sunday no no no he blasted off like a heat seeking missile at commanders quarterback jayden daniels first there was the second quarter strip sack that set up points then in the fourth quarter garrett walloped daniels twice for two pivotal sacks that helped seal the win on a day the offense couldn t find a groove man it was a weight off my shoulders garrett said of the three sacks that helped key l a s 20 13 win in his return from september knee surgery just getting back to who i am i m nowhere near where i want to be as far as like my performance and the things i know i can do how i can move but this is a confidence booster for sure just try to boost the confidence of the guys around me as well garrett played 35 of 58 defensive snaps 60 3 in his return from injury he generated six pressures and three sacks on 27 pass rushes 22 2 pressure rate per next gen stats getting the dominant edge rusher back will also make aaron donald more menacing sunday was the first time this season that garrett and donald were active together with both on the field 23 plays the rams defense allowed 5 0 yards per play and recorded four sacks per ngs on all other plays the defense allowed 8 1 yards per play and one touchdown with zero sacks as the duo plays together more the upside is enormous garrett s return is massive for a rams squad that has struggled this season they re finally on the right side of 500 at 5 4 but still have work to do to get into playoff positioning with puka nacua s reported knee injury adding uncertainty to sean mcvay s offense the l a d might need to carry the load for the next few weeks editor s update sean mcvay told reporters monday that wr puka nacua has mcl and pcl sprains and a turf toe injury and will probably be placed on injured reserve packers air it out to demolish pats many offenses prefer to dink and dunk their way down the field executing the kind of safe approach that doesn t put the ball at risk and keeps the attack in advantageous down and distance situations and then there is green bay jordan love entered sunday already leading the league in splash plays then he dropped dime after dime after deep dime on a bewildered patriots defense in foxborough the packers qb along with burner christian watson 7 171 1 and ascending second year wideout matthew golden 10 164 1 made pats star cb christian gonzalez look like a sixth round scrub putting himself squarely in the mvp conversation love generated 372 passing yards three passing touchdowns and a regular season career high 153 2 passer rating in green bay s 45 27 shellacking of the patriots he joined aaron rodgers as the only packers quarterbacks with multiple passing touchdowns in at least eight of the first nine games of a season with rodgers doing so in 2011 and 2020 winning mvp in each of those seasons love s 153 2 passer rating in week 9 is the highest by any packers quarterback in a regular season start since rodgers had a perfect 158 3 against the raiders in 2019 it really doesn t matter who it is on defense love said after the game we trust the game plan and trust guys are gonna get open and make plays it s the nfl we see great dbs every week our mindset is we gotta keep attacking attack they did love was flawless and his deep shots were on the freaking money when he s driving the ball downfield hitting receivers in stride there isn t a prettier sight in the game right now love completed 10 of his 12 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 294 yards and two touchdowns against the patriots the third most downfield passing yards by a quarterback this season per next gen stats he averaged 24 5 yards per attempt on those downfield passes the fifth most in a single game since 2018 he completed six of his eight deep attempts 20 air yards for 235 yards and one touchdown better still love was pressured on nine pass attempts he completed six of those for 153 yards averaging a whopping 17 0 ypa when pressured per ngs those numbers are pure comedy but it s crazy because i know there s probably a lot more in there golden said we ve still got so many more plays out there to make there are still aspects to clean up with the offensive line still somewhat of a mess and the ground game not getting into gear until late with josh jacobs now dealing with a fractured finger the pack could use some rb help jonathan taylor anyone but when love is on the money and his two dynamic receivers aren t flubbing passes the pack can score with anyone with the lions escaping miami on sunday with a 19 9 win over the fighting fins and the bears overcoming five turnovers to best the buccaneers at home the nfc north continues to be the hottest division in the league is anyone playing better than burrow jordan love is on fire but joe burrow has been blazing for a month the bengals quarterback in sunday s 34 17 win over the falcons generated his fourth straight game with at least four passing rushing touchdowns tied for the second longest streak since 1970 behind only peyton manning s five game streak in his 2004 mvp season per nfl research over the past four tilts burrow has a thrown hilarious 16 touchdown passes while completing 77 of his passes becoming just the fourth qb fifth instance overall to pull off that feat joining tom brady 2007 manning 2013 and russell wilson 2015 and 2020 joe is playing at an unbelievably high level right now bengals head coach zac taylor said joe doesn t force the ball he takes the ball where it needs to go based on the looks and even if sometimes they re leaning into a guy or doubling a guy he s still going to give him an opportunity and some of those opportunities came up big for us so that s just something we re used to it helps to have ja 39 marr chase 10 155 1 and tee higgins 5 32 2 on your side as they did at lsu burrow and chase toasted falcons corner a j terrell with a 47 yard td bomb to get the ball rolling on a 24 point first half that all but sealed a win in madrid before the break chase was asked after the game if burrow is playing like an mvp i can t answer that because i ve been playing with him my whole life so it s kind of hard for me to sit up here and say that chase said but i ve been thinking he should have won the mvp i said this when we went to the super bowl that year and he didn t get it that year i mean he s up for it every year broncos magic in one score games continues credit sean payton s squad for continuing to come up clutch streaking to their fifth consecutive victory on sunday four of which have come by less than a touchdown sunday s 26 21 win over the panthers came after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter the broncos fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that ties the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 per nfl research both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game on wild card weekend i think it s just the character of our guys the toughness competitiveness of our guys broncos quarterback bo nix said after the game we re just comfortable in that moment when things get close there at the end of the game whatever it is we have had a couple scores and then we always want to make it one score just glad we re on this side and winning em the broncos jumped out to a 10 0 advantage before the panthers got back in the game and took a third quarter lead carolina controlled the middle portion of the game but nix and co took over late with two fourth quarter touchdown drives capped by a 26 yard strike from nix to pat bryant after the offense failed to get a game sealing first down late the defense stepped up and forced a fumble to squash the panthers final drive i just think we ve been there before so we know how to handle the situation nik bonitto who had the game sealing strip sack of bryce young said at the end of the day it was our job as a defense to just go out and finish the victory set an nfl record with their 16th consecutive regular season win in a one score contest broncos games are rarely normal sunday s included a miraculous interception in the end zone that took a replay review of when payton s challenge flag was thrown before it could be reviewed we could say the magic will eventually run out and the broncos will regress to the mean in one score games however there have been enough of them to admit it s part of the makeup of payton s broncos maybe it will never be pretty but that win column sure looks nice right now for the 7 2 squad harbaugh s giants keep finding ways to win it s not just that john harbaugh has guided the giants to the top of the nfc east with a 5 2 1 record it s how they ve morphed into a reliable steady team that stands in stark contrast to the past decade plus of ineptitude for the most part the giants haven t beaten themselves sure there was cam skattebo s fumble against washington that led to a week 5 tie and jameis winston s early turnover barrage in their week 6 loss to new orleans but big blue has become better at not letting things unravel on sunday against a reeling eagles squad in a place lincoln financial field that has been a bugaboo for new york for a dozen years things could have spiraled out of control particularly when j j mccarthy exited due to a hip injury instead winston entered and calmly converted a third down and a fourth down to lead the giants only td drive of the game he then handed the reins back to mccarthy who finished out the win it was a prime example of all 46 active players doing their part to secure a victory perhaps more important than the offense doing just enough is a defense coming on strong under coordinator dennard wilson in previous years new york s offensive struggles got most of the attention despite the fact that the limp d had been equally or more disappointing given the up front talent under wilson this unit is a bullying menace stopping a sleepy eagles offense that saw joe milton start his first career game on sunday isn t anything to write home about on the surface but how new york did it is very noteworthy most notable arvell reese was a dominant force the rookie earned a career high three sacks and led the giants with 12 tackles becoming the first rookie since at least 1994 to record three sacks and at least 10 tackles in a game per nfl research reese joins fellow top five pick david bailey of the jets as the only rookies with at least three sacks in a game this season defensive rookie of the year that s set in stone cornerback greg newsome said of reece per the new york daily news now we re looking at defensive player of the year the superlatives for the rookie linebacker are just starting i don t know any young players that can do the things he does i m gonna be honest with you veteran defensive tackle d j reader said maybe the kid in seattle no 3 nick emmanwori because you don t find a kid that can cover the way he can cover come down and fill gaps in the run game rush the passer doesn t miss tackles kid s serious man it s special to watch he s really special the offense will come and go especially if the rushing attack is slowed like sunday but if big blue can rest its hat on a defense led by a dynamic rookie linebacker the giants can still run away with the nfc east week 9 sunday spotlight
